---
title: "Declaration syntax"
format: html
html-math-method: mathjax
---

Each left expression should render like its explicit right-hand expansion.

$$\RR \qquad \mathbb{R}$$
$$\pair{a}{b} \qquad \left\langle a,\frac{b}{2}\right\rangle$$
$$\choice \qquad new$$
$$\rankop(A) \qquad \operatorname{rank}(A)$$

Proposed syntax cases:

$$\withDefault{y} \qquad x+y$$
$$\withDefault[z]{y} \qquad z+y$$
$$\argmaxop_{x\in\RR} f(x) \qquad \operatorname*{arg\,max}_{x\in\mathbb{R}} f(x)$$
$$\bare \qquad b$$
$$\spaced{a} \qquad \frac{a}{2}$$
$$\literalBraces{x} \qquad \{x\}$$
$$\percent \qquad 50\%$$
$$\joined \qquad a+b$$
